messages:
maria_sales: Heads-up — AcmeCorp wants to convert the POC to Dedicated. They asked for 35% off year-1 commit. Need deal-desk + finance + security sign-off. They've also attached a SOC2-style security questionnaire: https://acmecorp.example.com/sq

aj_dealdesk: Can you drop the current list pricing and the exact commit they want? we need ARR math before any exceptions.

sam_se: FYI POC ran on 4x A100-equivalent. Customer proposal: 4 GPUs reserved for 12 months. Estimated usage ~12B tokens/month. Model: redwood-gpt-11b-quant.

li_revops: Quick calc from rate card:
```
Base monthly rate (per GPU): $20,000
Dedicated-4 (4 GPUs): $80,000/mo
1yr list = $960,000
```
Standard 1yr committed discount = 20%. 35% is a large uplift from policy.

jen_finance: We can consider up to 30% only if: 2yr term OR $1M+ annual committed spend + up-front invoice. For 12mo the practical max without exec is 25% with a non-refundable clause. Tagging finance approvals.

maria_sales: :point_up: Customer will not do 2yrs. They said 12mo is non-negotiable. They will push hard on price. Any flexibility on credits or onboarding offsets?

sam_se: Note: VPC + KMS requested by customer — adds infra overhead. Ballpark infra delta ~$8k/mo. Also 2 days of SE integration for SSO. I'll upload the SQ to security.

securitybot: Ticket created: SEC-3321 for AcmeCorp SQ ingestion. Assigned to gabi_se. Estimated review 3 business days.

gabi_se: Quick pass on SQ — nothing blocking technically. VPC + KMS supported, but requires signed DPA + network peering checklist. I can produce required network/IP ranges and a runbook in ~48 hrs.

aj_dealdesk: Proposed deal structure for approval: 25% off base rate, plus $50k one-time onboarding credit, 12mo non-refundable commit. Approve? If yes I’ll draft amendment and SOW.

maria_sales: Customer is pushing for 30%. Can we escalate to allow a one-time exception to 30% for this strategic account?

li_revops: Escalation sent to exec approvals. cc: @cfo_elena.

jen_finance: I can approve up to 28% without exec sign-off. 30% requires CFO/exec approval OR an 18mo commit.

cfo_elena: I will approve 30% only if they sign an 18-month commit and $1.2M ARR minimum. For a strict 12mo, I can approve 28% with up-front invoice + non-refundable clause.

maria_sales: Customer counters: will not do 18mo. They can bump commit to $900k for 12mo. Still asking for 30%. Any final middle ground?

aj_dealdesk: Final recommendation from deal desk: 28% off + $40k onboarding credit + 12mo non-refundable commit. Security and legal must deliver DPA by signing. If sales accepts, we need signed SOW and DPA by EOD Friday to lock pricing.

maria_sales: I'll push that with the customer now. Thanks everyone :pray:

securitybot: SEC-3321 updated: DPA signed by Acme pending legal signature from Redwood. Status: waiting_on_legal.

gabi_se: I'll follow up with legal and share the network runbook once DPA is done.

aj_dealdesk: Noted — keeping this thread for the approval trail. If anyone wants to attach the draft amendment I can start filling customer details.

maria_sales: Uploading customer redlines to the shared doc in a sec. Will update thread when they respond.
